source: Product-owner-authorized red, gunmetal, dark tangerine, off-white and dim gray rebrand, October 23 2026
method: Built-in imagegen palette reference followed by deterministic Sharp palette normalization of original artwork, preserving exact alpha masks and dimensions.

prompts.paletteMigration: Recolor the exact FixxFlow logo: American red #BD212C ribbon and Flow, gunmetal #282D33 folds, off-white #FBFFFE wrench and inverse wordmark. Preserve silhouette, typography, layout and transparency.

derivatives: All logo variants, source masters, app icons, favicon PNGs and ICO use the red-and-gunmetal palette. Monochrome variants retain their single-color role.
darkArtwork: Original alpha masks preserved. No backing plaque added. Launcher icons retain their intentional background.
